panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A1, A2, B1, B2). A1: Frontal clinical photograph of the 6-month-old patient with cat-eye syndrome (article title and caption) showing the captioned craniofacial dysmorphism: hypertelorism, downslanting palpebral fissures and malformed external ears/preauricular tags. Additional described features (thin upper lip, retrognathism) are not in the vocabulary. A2: Profile clinical photograph of the same 6-month-old patient with cat-eye syndrome, showing the malformed external ear and craniofacial dysmorphism described in the caption. B1: Frontal clinical photograph of the same patient at 3.5 years with cat-eye syndrome, showing the captioned facial dysmorphism (hypertelorism, downslanting palpebral fissures, ear malformation). B2: Profile clinical photograph of the same patient at 3.5 years with cat-eye syndrome, showing the malformed external ear and craniofacial dysmorphism described in the caption.
panels.attribution_text: Jedraszak et al. Severe psychomotor delay in a severe presentation of cat-eye syndrome.. Case reports in genetics 2015. doi:10.1155/2015/943905. CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figure 1.
panels.figure_caption: Craniofacial dysmorphism. Pictures of the patient at the age of 6 months (top panel) and 3 and a half (bottom panel). The facial dysmorphism consisted in hypertelorism, downslanting palpebral fissures, a thin upper lip, retrognathism, an irregularly shaped skull, and severe malformation of the external ears.
in_text_mentions: 38 weeks of gestation, with a birth weight of 2800 g (10th percentile) and a head circumference of 35 cm (50–75th percentile). A clinical examination revealed an imperforate anus, facial dysmorphism (Figure 1), general hypotonia, and bilateral malformation of the external ears (present as several tags, in combination with atresia of the external auditory canal) (Figure 1). Hearing tests evidenced a 70 dB bilateral conductive hearing loss. A CT scan showed bilateral hypoplasia of the tympanic cavity and right-side hypoplasia of the middle ear.
